answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, weighted by independent path length, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The walnut holds work receipts rather than names, so the wander of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. What survives to the zenith is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
